“作词？”

魏沐闻言眉眼闪动了一下。

“对。”

宋柯轻轻点头。

“陈嘉上导演非常喜欢藤原育郎创作的这首钢琴曲，他已经联系对方进行编曲，剩下的就是填词和演唱。”

“魏沐，这是一个机会！！”

什么机会？

演唱主题曲的机会。

而且是大热电影主题曲！！

《画皮》阵容强大，汇聚陈琨，某薇以及周训三位一线明星。

这部电影在拍摄时出了不少幺蛾子，如今电影将于下半年上映，人气依旧势不可挡。

“如果电影火了，你唱的歌也会跟着火，这有助于提升你的人气。”

“老宋，你对《画皮》这么有信心？”

魏沐有些惊讶。

要知道，《画皮》这部电影从立项之初就是破事不断。

最初的翻拍计划由香港导演钱永强发起，他找来了叶伟信做导演，甄子丹做男主角。

可惜第一版剧本太过魔幻，被内地审查驳回，直接导致项目还没开拍便已亏损200万。

只好找来陈嘉上救火。

没想到请神容易送神难，陈嘉上和钱永强在创作理念上出现冲突，随即后者退出剧组。

导演撕逼结束，又轮到演员撕逼。

魏沐上辈子做短视频博主的时候，喜欢吐槽四大普女。

这几位妹子，颜值一般，抢番位却一个比一个狠。

追本溯源，内娱撕番的开山鼻祖就是这部《画皮》

某薇和周训两位大花，从海报到合同再到片酬，从粉丝到经纪人再到公司，没有不争的。

所到之处一片狼藉。

“不管电影是否大卖，总要试一下吧？你想把机会让给张靓颖？”

老宋说明大致情况。

陈嘉上一开始没想到找太和麦田，人家是香港人，而香港就有不少优秀的填词人。

年轻点的有林夕黄伟文，老一辈有黄霑林振强。

原版《画心》的填词人叫陈少琪，是香港老牌作词家，作品有梅艳芳《夕阳之歌》张国容《风再起时》，能力没得说。

张靓颖是华艺兄弟签约的歌手，他们那边一直在接触这个项目，表示可以演唱主题曲。

魏沐现在一个专辑没有发售，单靠《体面》积累的人气根本干不过张靓颖。

所以，老宋想到了歌词，如果魏沐把歌词写好，给陈嘉上看，对方满意。

那么这件事就稳了！！

“我可是费了好大劲才拿下这个项目，你尽全力去写，不管什么结果我都能接受。”

看得出来，老宋确实在为他着想。

"Writing lyrics?"

Wei Mu's eyebrows flashed when he heard this.

"Yes."

Song Ke nodded lightly.

"Director Chen Jiashang likes this piano piece composed by Fujiwara Ikuro very much. He has already contacted the other party to arrange the music. The rest is to write lyrics and sing."

"Wei Mu, this is an opportunity!!"

What opportunity?

Opportunity to sing the theme song.

And it’s a hit movie theme song!!

"Painted Skin" has a strong cast, bringing together three first-line stars: Chen Kun, Mou Wei and Zhou Xun.

There were a lot of glitches during the filming of this movie. Now that the movie will be released in the second half of the year, its popularity is still unstoppable.

"If the movie becomes popular, the songs you sing will also become popular, which will help increase your popularity."

"Old Song, are you so confident in "Painted Skin"?"

Wei Mu was a little surprised.

You know, the movie "Painted Skin" has been troubled from the beginning.

The original remake plan was initiated by Hong Kong director Chin Wing-keung, who hired Wilson Yip as director and Donnie Yen as the leading actor.

Unfortunately, the first version of the script was too magical and was rejected by mainland reviewers, which directly led to the project losing 2 million before filming even started.

We had no choice but to call in Chen Jiashang to put out the fire.

Unexpectedly, it is easier to invite gods than to send them away. Chen Jiashang and Qian Yongqiang had conflicts in their creative ideas, and the latter immediately quit the crew.

The director's quarrel is over, and it's the actor's turn to quarrel again.

When Wei Mu was a short video blogger in his previous life, he liked to complain about the four popular women.

These girls have average looks, but each one is more ruthless than the other when competing for spots.

Tracing back to its origins, the originator of domestic entertainment drama is "Painted Skin"

Wei and Zhou Xun, two big stars, have nothing to dispute from posters to contracts to remuneration, from fans to agents to the company.

Everywhere he went was a mess.

"No matter whether the movie is a hit or not, you still have to give it a try, right? Do you want to give the opportunity to Jane Zhang?"

Lao Song explained the general situation.

Chen Jiashang didn't expect to find Taihe Maitian at first. He is from Hong Kong, and Hong Kong has many excellent lyricists.

The younger ones include Lin Xi and Huang Weiwen, and the older generation includes Huang Zhan and Lin Zhenqiang.

The lyricist of the original version of "Painted Heart" is Chen Shaoqi, a veteran Hong Kong lyricist. His works include Anita Mui's "Song of the Sunset" and Zhang Guorong's "When the Wind Rises Again". His ability is beyond words.

Zhang Liangying is a singer signed by Huayi Brothers. They have been in contact with this project and said that they can sing the theme song.

Wei Mu currently has no album released, and the popularity accumulated by "Decent" alone cannot rival Jane Zhang.

Therefore, Lao Song thought of the lyrics. If Wei Mu wrote the lyrics and showed them to Chen Jia, the other party would be satisfied.

Then this matter is settled!!

"I worked hard to win this project. If you try your best to write it, I can accept the result no matter what."

It can be seen that Lao Song is really thinking about him.
